author: Copilot
body:
`StatusCell` renders an icon-only `IconButton` without an accessible name (no `aria-label`). When used as a tooltip trigger this leaves keyboard/screen-reader users with an unnamed control.

Also, the inline `style={{ outline: 'none', boxShadow: 'none' }}` suppresses the focus-visible ring styles from `IconButton`, removing the visible focus indicator.

author: Copilot
body:
`align` currently only toggles `justify-center` / `flex-row-reverse` on the inner wrapper, but the wrapper isn't forced to span the full header cell width, and the outer column remains `text-left`. In practice this likely won't right-align/center the header content as intended (e.g. `align="right"` in the new DataTable story).

Also, `title={`Sort ${sortDirection}`}` will produce `"Sort undefined"` when the column isn't sorted; use a stable label like "Sort" / "Not sorted" or derive from `sortDirection ?? 'none'`.

author: Copilot
body:
`durationValue` returns the provided value (or 0 for reduced motion) and is used elsewhere with millisecond values (e.g. `durationValue(150)`). Passing `0.15` here makes the transition effectively instantaneous; this should likely be `150` (or `0.15` without `durationValue` if `motion` expects seconds, but then other call sites should be consistent).
```suggestion
        transition={{ duration: durationValue(150), ease: 'easeInOut' }}
```

author: Copilot
body: `ExpandCell` can render an icon-only button when `isExpandable` is true, but `ariaLabel` is optional and may be omitted, resulting in an unnamed control for assistive tech. Consider making `ariaLabel` required when the toggle is rendered (or providing a sensible default like "Expand row" / "Collapse row").
